summary_en: A classic Pac-Man remake for the browser with ghost AI and mazes.
summary_zh: 经典吃豆人浏览器复刻，含幽灵 AI 和多张迷宫。
howto_en: Arrow keys to move through the maze, eat all dots, avoid ghosts.
howto_zh: 方向键在迷宫中移动，吃光豆子，避开幽灵。

summary_en: Minimal Pac-Man clone on HTML5 canvas, CC0 public domain.
summary_zh: 极简 HTML5 Canvas 吃豆人，CC0 公共领域。
howto_en: Arrow keys.
howto_zh: 方向键控制。

summary_en: Jake Gordon's clean Tetris implementation in pure JS, no framework.
summary_zh: Jake Gordon 的纯 JS 俄罗斯方块，无框架依赖，代码优雅。
howto_en: Arrow keys move/rotate, space drops.
howto_zh: 方向键移动旋转，空格硬降。

summary_en: OutRun-style pseudo-3D racing game on canvas. Select tracks, dodge traffic.
summary_zh: OutRun 风格伪 3D 竞速，Canvas 渲染。选赛道、躲车辆。
howto_en: Arrow keys or WASD steer, accelerate, brake.
howto_zh: 方向键或 WASD 控制方向和油门，刹车。

summary_en: Open-source factory-building puzzle: cut, rotate, merge shapes to match orders.
summary_zh: 开源形状工厂经营：切割、旋转、合并形状完成订单。
howto_en: Mouse click and drag to build conveyor belts and machines.
howto_zh: 鼠标点击与拖拽建造传送带和机器。

summary_en: The world's first Minesweeper implemented in pure CSS with no JavaScript.
summary_zh: 全球首个纯 CSS 扫雷，零 JavaScript。
howto_en: Click cells to reveal, right-click to flag mines.
howto_zh: 左键揭示格子，右键插旗标雷。

summary_en: A robust, extensible JavaScript chessboard with drag-and-drop piece movement.
summary_zh: 功能强大的 JS 国际象棋棋盘，支持拖拽走子。
howto_en: Drag pieces to move them. Full FEN import/export.
howto_zh: 拖拽棋子走子，支持 FEN 格式导入导出。

summary_en: Space Invaders in pure HTML5 canvas. Defend Earth from waves of aliens.
summary_zh: 纯 Canvas 太空侵略者，射击外星舰队保卫地球。
howto_en: Arrow keys move, space to shoot.
howto_zh: 方向键移动，空格射击。

summary_en: A beautifully crafted Space Invaders clone for the browser.
summary_zh: 精心打磨的浏览器太空侵略者复刻。
howto_en: Arrow keys + space.
howto_zh: 方向键与空格。

summary_en: Interactive voxel island you can explore in the browser. Click and fly around.
summary_zh: 浏览器里可交互的体素岛屿，点击飞行漫游。
howto_en: Mouse drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, click to interact.
howto_zh: 拖拽旋转视角，滚轮缩放，点击互动。

summary_en: Free turn-based strategy: summon creatures, capture enemies, destroy the boss.
summary_zh: 免费回合制策略：召唤生物、收服敌方单位、击杀 Boss。
howto_en: Click to move and attack. Turn-based grid combat.
howto_zh: 点击移动与攻击，网格回合制战斗。

summary_en: A minimalist text adventure that starts with stoking a fire and grows into a sprawling story.
summary_zh: 极简文字冒险：从生火开始，逐步展开宏大世界观。
howto_en: Click to interact. Manage resources and explore the narrative.
howto_zh: 点击交互，管理资源，探索剧情。

summary_en: Flappy Bird clone built with Phaser framework, featuring cute sprite art.
summary_zh: 基于 Phaser 的 Flappy Bird 复刻，像素画风。
howto_en: Click or press space to flap.
howto_zh: 点击或空格键拍打翅膀。

summary_en: A mahjong tile matching game for the browser.
summary_zh: 浏览器麻将连连看。
howto_en: Click matching tile pairs to clear the board.
howto_zh: 点击两张相同的牌消除。

summary_en: Three variations of the classic Breakout/Arkanoid paddle game.
summary_zh: 三种经典打砖块变体。
howto_en: Move mouse or arrow keys to control the paddle.
howto_zh: 鼠标或方向键控制挡板。

summary_en: Collection of classic mini-games built on HTML5 canvas from a game dev workshop.
summary_zh: 游戏开发工作坊产出的 HTML5 Canvas 经典小游戏合集。
howto_en: Keyboard to play each demo.
howto_zh: 键盘操控各游戏 Demo。

summary_en: A physics puzzle from js13kGames where you launch Werner from a catapult.
summary_zh: js13k 物理弹射解谜，用弹弓发射维尔纳。
howto_en: Mouse drag to aim and launch.
howto_zh: 鼠标拖拽瞄准弹射。

summary_en: The classic Snake game rendered in the browser with React.
summary_zh: React 实现的经典贪吃蛇。
howto_en: Arrow keys to steer the snake into food without hitting walls.
howto_zh: 方向键引导蛇吃豆，别撞墙。

summary_en: An enhanced 2048 variant with improved touch controls and animations.
summary_zh: 触屏操控增强版 2048，动画更流畅。
howto_en: Swipe to move tiles.
howto_zh: 滑动移动方块。

summary_en: Place block pieces onto a 10x10 grid to fill complete rows/columns and clear them.
summary_zh: 把方块放到 10×10 格子上，填满整行/列即可消除。
howto_en: Drag pieces onto the grid.
howto_zh: 拖拽方块到网格。
